note: Expected profile detection for tests/fixtures/nc/okuma (plan M8 §8.4). Owner: WP8.3, G10 fix M8.
One file per folder under tests/fixtures/nc, read by src/lib/core/profiles/detect.test.ts; the margin
over the runner-up is asserted and printed by src/lib/data/profiles/fanucLathe.test.ts, which globs
this folder too, and again with the content score alone by src/lib/data/profiles/okuma.test.ts.
A value is a profile id, or 'fallback' when the content is inconclusive and the current profile
stays, or 'refused' when decodeFile does not open the file at all.
The .MIN, .SUB and .SSB extensions belong to this control alone and decide on their own: line by
line an Okuma turning program reads like Fanuc lathe code, so no content outvotes them. Under any
other extension the $NAME.MIN% header decides just as firmly, and without a header the syntax only
this control writes does (CALL O, RTS, the driven-tool cycles G180-G189, a LAP call, a G71 thread
cycle with H and D, a G77 tap with K, a line continued with $). SHAFT-OP2 (no extension, no header)
and detect-okuma.txt carry no extension weight at all, so they are the files that say whether the
content rules alone carry the dialect; o05-lap-tap.MIN holds the lines the newer rules need.
Programs under a foreign extension, the reviewer's among them, are in _improvements.json.
